newsitem.title: UK: Ellis & Everard buys chemicals distributor.
newsitem.headline: Ellis & Everard buys chemicals distributor.

text.p: British distribution company Ellis & Everard said on Monday that it had acquired in full privately-owned Chemitrade (Holdings) Ltd, for a cash price of 7.4 million stg.
The company, which distributes solvents, had 1995 turnover of 56 million stg and net assets valued at about 3.6 million stg. Ellis said it would fund the deal from existing borrowing.
"The addition of Chemitrade to our existing business makes us the leading distributor of solvents in the UK. The strategic fit is excellent," a statement quoted chief executive Peter Wood as saying.
